title: Support Tickets (Lite)
summary: Customer support tickets with teams, stages and assignment, on Odoo 19 Community
intro: A customer writes in, and the request becomes a numbered ticket that belongs to a team, has an owner, and sits in a stage on a Kanban board. Drag it across as the work moves on. When it lands in a closing stage the closing date is recorded for you. Chatter, followers and scheduled activities come as standard, so the whole conversation stays on the record.
shots: The Tickets Kanban board filtered on Open: five numbered tickets (TKT/00001 to TKT/00006) with their customer and priority stars, sitting in the New, In Progress, Waiting on Customer and Solved columns.
features: Every ticket takes a unique reference from a sequence, so it can be quoted on the phone or in an email and found again instantly.
A team has members and an optional default assignee. Members see their team's tickets; the default assignee picks up anything created without an owner.
Ordered stages, global or specific to one team, each with a folded flag for the Kanban and a closing flag that stamps the closing date.
Drag and drop between stages, bulk edit from the list, and a form carrying the description, tags, priority and the full chatter.
My tickets, unassigned, my teams, open, closed, urgent, blocked and opened this month, with group by stage, team, assignee, priority or customer.
A pivot and a bar chart of tickets by team, assignee and stage, built straight on the ticket records rather than a custom SQL view.
notes: Two access groups: a user works with their own teams' tickets, a manager sees everything and maintains teams, stages and tags.
Record rules enforce the visibility, so it holds in the API and in exports, not only in the interface.
Stages are plain records. Rename them, reorder them or add a team specific column without touching code.
Depends only on base and mail. Nothing else is dragged into your database.
The lite edition has no incoming mail gateway: tickets are created in the interface or through the API.
paid_sentence: The drkds Support Desk app adds service level policies, a customer portal, satisfaction ratings, canned replies and ticket merging.
